Test: TC-5874 — SPM - OKR - Opening linked box key in multiple views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-513 OKR - Linking Boxes To KR
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Steps:
1. Open OKR module in boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-5874 SPM - OKR - Opening linked box key in multiple views
   Expected: OKR module is opened. No OKR connected to this box message is visible
2. Navigate to OKR settings → General and enable "*Displaying connected boxes in the OKR Overview*"
   Expected: Displaying connected boxes in the OKR Overview is enabled
3. Navigate to OKR Overview → Layout → Display settings and enable *Show connected Boxes*
   Expected: Showing connected boxes is enabled
4. Create Objective and Key-result
   Data: * Objective 1
* KR-1
   Expected: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR Overview
5. Open Key-result → click *Edit linked boxes* button → in box name field find boxNames, select and click save
   Data: boxName: TC-5874 SPM - OKR - Opening linked box key in multiple views
   Expected: Boxes are linked to Key-result. Linked box is visible in *Linked issues & boxes* in KR detail
6. Being in *Linked issues & boxes* section click on linked box key
   Expected: Gantt module is opened
7. Open OKR module → OKR Overview →  hover over to KR-1 and click on linked box key
   Data: boxName: TC-5874 SPM - OKR - Opening linked box key in multiple views
   Expected: Gantt module is opened
